identity.name: Windows Endpoint Command Execution via Kubelet Credentials in Pod
identity.summary: An attacker executes commands from a Windows endpoint within a Kubernetes pod using kubelet credentials. Cortex should detect the execution of suspicious commands and anomalous process behaviors.

biocs.name: Suspicious PowerShell Execution in Pod Context
biocs.description: PowerShell process started with command line indicating download and execution of malware
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'malware.exe'

abiocs.name: Unusual Process Start from Kubelet Context
abiocs.description: PowerShell process started from within a Kubernetes pod with kubelet credentials
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name contains 'kubelet'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'

xql_queries.name: Detect PowerShell Execution from Kubelet
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name contains 'kubelet'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'malware.exe'
